replication_status: Parent study family; companion GENDEP publications not independent

citation: Chamberlain et al. Treatment-resistant depression and peripheral C-reactive protein. Br J Psychiatry. 2019

treatment_exposure: Prior antidepressant treatment exposure differs by group
comparator: TRD vs responsive vs untreated vs healthy
effect_estimate: BMI-corrected CRP higher in TRD vs healthy Cohen d 0.47

replication_status: Independent family for enrichment not prediction

citation: Raison et al. Randomized controlled trial of infliximab for treatment-resistant depression. JAMA Psychiatry. 2013

citation: Hummad et al. The Role of Inflammatory Markers as Predictors of Response to Antidepressants in MDD: A Meta-Analysis. Cureus. 2026

citation: Altered Cytokine Levels in First Episode MDD and Antidepressant-Naive Patients: systematic review and meta-analysis. 2025
population: 17 studies 1371 MDD patients in first-episode or drug-naive comparisons
